body_markdown:
[Back](https://atlas.so/changelog)


Nov 19th, 2024


📎 Images & attachments upgrades


We've made it easier to handle images and attachments in your customer chats. Check out what's new:


- **📷 Inline Images in Composer** : Add, resize, or remove images directly in your messages across email, chat, and slack.


- **🖼️ Drag & Drop in Chat** : Customers can now drag and drop images into the chat widget or paste from their clipboard, making it quicker to share images.


- **📁 Attachments in Canned Responses** : Include attachments in your canned responses for faster file sharing, saving you time and effort.
